broadcasts.message: normalize.js remains faithful and unchanged. NFKC, lowercase, whitespace collapse to single ASCII space, trim. No word modifications. All peers aligned.
tokenizer.js remains unchanged and correct. Faithful to spec: calls normalize once, extracts ASCII alphanumeric runs with interior apostrophes, preserves order. No issues.
pipeline.js unchanged and correct. It uses Object.create(null) for frequencies and hasOwnProperty to handle 'constructor' safely. Faithful to token order and counts. Ready for final round.
